name: hashscraper
description: Coupang and Naver Shopping top 30 and public web data bots (Instagram, maps, reviews) for AI agents
long_description: Collect public web data from your AI agent with HashScraper's 120+ ready-made data bots — Coupang and Naver Shopping best-seller top 30 by category, Naver blog/cafe/news/shopping/maps, Instagram, YouTube, Olive Young, Musinsa, Kurly, KREAM, Google/Kakao maps, app stores and more. Connect your account with the login tool (free sign-up included) or set an API key from My page -> API.

hashscraper_api_key.title: HashScraper API key (optional)
hashscraper_api_key.description: Optional. A HashScraper API key from My page -> API at https://www.hashscraper.com. Leave empty and use the login tool to connect in the browser.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Connect your HashScraper account in the browser (device login, free sign-up included).

tools.name: me
tools.description: Show the connected account and how many daily free credits are left today.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Search the built-in list of 120+ ready-made data bots and their inputs. The built-in list works offline; once connected it also searches bots made by HashScraper members, live.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Collect public web data with one HashScraper bot (built-in, or one made by a member via public_bot) and return the rows.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the rows of an earlier run by dataset id.

tools.name: coupang_categories
tools.description: List the Coupang categories whose daily best-selling top 30 is ready.

tools.name: coupang_top
tools.description: Get today's best-selling top 30 products of a Coupang category with price, reviews and delivery.

tools.name: naver_categories
tools.description: List the Naver Shopping categories whose daily best-selling top 30 is ready.

tools.name: naver_top
tools.description: Get the latest daily best-selling top 30 products of a Naver Shopping category with price, reviews and store.
